meta.name: parallel-debugging
meta.description: Debug complex issues using competing hypotheses with parallel investigation, evidence collection, and root cause arbitration. Use this skill when debugging bugs with multiple potential causes, performing root cause analysis, or organizing parallel investigation workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行验证多个假设,揪出复杂 bug 的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对原因不明的复杂 bug,想用并行调查法快速定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Parallelize hypothesis testing to pinpoint root causes of complex bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck on a tricky bug with multiple possible causes and want a systematic way to find the root cause

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会针对复杂 bug 提出多个互相竞争的假设(涵盖逻辑、数据、状态、集成、资源、环境六类失败模式),分头收集带「文件:行号」的证据,再仲裁出根因并列出修复验证清单。
howto.when: 当 bug 存在多个可能原因、初次排查没找出问题,或问题跨多个模块时,这个技能会接管排查流程。

say.text: 这个 bug 有几种可能原因,帮我并行排查
say.note: 会生成多个假设并分头取证

say.text: 帮我做一次根因分析,证据标出文件:行号
say.note: 按证据强弱分级并仲裁根因

say.text: 先别下结论,把所有可能原因列出来再逐一排除
say.note: 按六类失败模式列假设

howto.what_en: Claude proposes competing hypotheses for a complex bug (covering logic, data, state, integration, resource, environment failure modes), gathers file:line evidence in parallel, then arbitrates the root cause and lists fix checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a bug has multiple plausible causes, initial debugging failed, or the issue spans several modules; the skill then takes over the investigation.

say_en.text: This bug has several possible causes - investigate them in parallel
say_en.note: Generates competing hypotheses and gathers evidence

say_en.text: Do a root cause analysis and cite evidence as file:line
say_en.note: Grades evidence strength and arbitrates the cause

say_en.text: Don't conclude yet - list all possible causes and rule them out
say_en.note: Lists hypotheses across six failure modes
